prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new reusable western character illustration for the Uncommon Leaders Austin event. The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Match its vintage western engraving/woodcut stock-illustration language very closely: bold irregular hand-cut cream contours, selective short parallel hatch marks, broad solid ink shapes, large deep-green negative areas, simplified expressive details. Do not turn it into dense photorealistic etching, modern vector clipart, a cartoon mascot, or 3D. Two colors only: perfectly flat deep forest green #192520 background and muted warm cream ink approximately #B4B9AF matching the reference. No gradients, no additional colors, no cast shadow, no border, no words, no labels, no logo, no stars, no scenic backdrop. Entire character and all accessories fully visible with generous clear margins, isolated and centered. Clean readable silhouette and anatomically coherent joints suitable for a later restrained animation. Wide 16:9 composition, highest available resolution, ideally 3840x2160. This is a polished character concept asset, not a finished presentation slide. Subject: a handsome adult Texas longhorn, full body, standing calmly in a three-quarter view, body angled left and face turned slightly toward the viewer. Extra-wide sweeping horns with clear natural curvature, both horns fully inside frame; four anatomically correct legs and hooves, a relaxed tail, alert ears, a strong dignified head. Use bold sparse engraved shapes for its coat and shoulder muscles, not thousands of tiny fur lines. One foreleg may be slightly relaxed. Just a few minimal engraved grass strokes near the hooves. Give it the same vintage print character and line weight as the horse in the reference, with enough facial personality to later animate an ear flick and small head turn. Animal occupies about 70% of canvas width and 65% of height.

transparent_edits.instruction: Preserve each approved character, remove the green background, and render the engraved ink in dark forest green on true transparency. The dancing cowgirl received a second edit to remove the cream fill left by the first pass.
